title: Jewel Toned Light Algerian Avocado Tagine
description: A citrusy and cozy Algerian dish featuring avocado, with a focus on ayurvedic and sattvic friendly ingredients, cooked in an agave leaf vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the avocado into large chunks and set aside.
In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, ginger, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Place the agave leaf in a large baking dish and brush the inside with the olive oil mixture.
Arrange the avocado chunks in the center of the agave leaf.
Pour the remaining olive oil mixture over the avocado.
Fold the agave leaf over the avocado to create a packet.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the avocado is tender.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
